facts.business: R Systems International Limited is a digital product engineering company providing services across software product engineering, cloud and DevOps, data and AI, quality engineering, embedded systems and firmware, automation and digital operations, experience design, and application modernization.

guidance_or_targets.statement: AI revenue accounted for approximately 29% of overall revenue during FY 2025, a share the company expects to grow in the coming years.

key_risks: Distance between a capable AI tool and a useful production outcome under governance is wider than product demonstrations suggested
Closing the AI deployment gap requires engineering judgment that tools cannot supply on their own
Team-level velocity, cycle times, and portfolio throughput largely stayed flat despite individual productivity gains from AI
Cost engineering of AI workloads becoming a board-level discussion as token economics show up in CFO conversations
